input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including base model, user, role, user account. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, permission loader, user account. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage base model records, so that I can track and organize base model data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user account records, so that I can track and organize user account data effectively.
